BiblicalUsage: Crooked is the word for a path that will not run straight, and the Bible uses it for men who will not walk straight either. In Deuteronomy 32:5 Moses calls Israel a perverse and crooked generation, in Proverbs 2:15 the wicked walk in crooked paths, in Proverbs 8:8 wisdom says all her words are plain and there is nothing froward or perverse in them, and in Proverbs 11:20 the froward in heart are an abomination to the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the crooked path is always a choice: wisdom walks straight and plain. The heart that turns aside knows exactly what it is doing.
